日.meaningMnemonic: On its own, the kanji for day also means the sun itself, the thing that makes the day.
日.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひ. Picture the sun so hot you shout "hee!" when it touches your skin.

一つ.meaningMnemonic: The kanji for one plus the little つ ending is how you count one thing.
一つ.readingMnemonic: This uses the kun'yomi ひと plus つ. The つ ending is the native Japanese way of counting objects.

一日.meaningMnemonic: One plus day gives one day, or a whole day from morning to night.
一日.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use their on'yomi: いち from one and にち from day, which you already know.

一.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is just the number one.
一.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi いち, the same itch you remember from the kanji.

国.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a country or a region.
国.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi くに, not the cook reading. Picture the royal cook saying "coo, nee" as he looks over his country.

一人.meaningMnemonic: One plus person means one person, or being all alone.
一人.readingMnemonic: This is an irregular reading: ひとり. Learn it as a whole word; it does not use いち or じん.

人.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a person, someone.
人.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひと, the same ひと you saw in 一人.

一人一人.meaningMnemonic: One person, then one person again: each person, one by one.
一人一人.readingMnemonic: It is simply ひとり said twice: ひとりひとり.

年.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a year, or a person's age in years.
年.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi とし, not the nun reading. Picture the nun counting years on her toes, "toe, she" says.

大人.meaningMnemonic: A large person is a grown up, an adult.
大人.readingMnemonic: This is an irregular reading, おとな. It does not use だい or じん; learn it as one word.

大きい.meaningMnemonic: The kanji for large plus the い ending makes the adjective big.
大きい.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おお plus きい, so おおきい. Picture someone shouting "oh!" at something big.

大きな.meaningMnemonic: Another way to say big, used right before a noun.
大きな.readingMnemonic: Same おお as 大きい, but it ends in きな instead of きい: おおきな.

大いに.meaningMnemonic: Large turned into an adverb: very much, greatly.
大いに.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おお plus いに: おおいに.

大した.meaningMnemonic: Large in importance: something considerable or great.
大した.readingMnemonic: Here the kanji uses its other on'yomi たい, plus した: たいした.

大.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means large or great, often as a size label.
大.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi だい, the purple dye from the kanji.

十日.meaningMnemonic: Ten plus day gives ten days, or the tenth day of the month.
十日.readingMnemonic: This is a special date reading: とおか. Ten is read とお here and day is read か.

十.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number ten.
十.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi じゅう, the jewel from the kanji.

二つ.meaningMnemonic: Two plus the つ counting ending: two things.
二つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ふた plus つ: ふたつ.

二人.meaningMnemonic: Two plus person: two people, a pair.
二人.readingMnemonic: Like 一人, this is irregular: ふたり. Learn it together with ひとり.

二日.meaningMnemonic: Two plus day: two days, or the second day of the month.
二日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: ふつか. It does not use に or にち.

二.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number two.
二.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi に, the knee from the kanji.

二十日.meaningMnemonic: Twenty plus day: twenty days, or the twentieth day of the month.
二十日.readingMnemonic: A special reading: はつか. Learn it as one word, because none of the usual readings appear.

二十.meaningMnemonic: Two tens make twenty; this word means twenty years old.
二十.readingMnemonic: When it means twenty years old, it has its own reading: はたち. A big birthday gets a special word.

本.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a book.
本.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ほん, the honk from the kanji.

本人.meaningMnemonic: The book's own person: the person in question, the one themselves.
本人.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ほん plus にん, the second reading of person.

日本.meaningMnemonic: The sun's origin: the land where the sun rises, Japan.
日本.readingMnemonic: Day becomes に and book stays ほん: にほん. The stronger form にっぽん doubles the sound.

中.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the inside of something.
中.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi なか. Picture the inside of a box so dark you say "nah, ka" and back away.

中々.meaningMnemonic: Inside, then inside again: quite deeply, so very or considerably.
中々.readingMnemonic: It is なか said twice: なかなか. The 々 mark repeats the kanji before it.

年中.meaningMnemonic: Inside the year: all year round.
年中.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi, with a sound change: ねん plus じゅう, so ねんじゅう. The ちゅう of inside picks up a voiced sound.

日中.meaningMnemonic: Inside the day: during the daytime.
日中.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: にち plus ちゅう, squeezed into にっちゅう.

長い.meaningMnemonic: The kanji for long plus the い ending: the adjective long.
長い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なが plus い: ながい.

出る.meaningMnemonic: Exit as a verb: to leave or to go out.
出る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi で plus る: でる.

出す.meaningMnemonic: To make something exit: to take it out or put it out.
出す.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi だ plus す: だす. Compare でる, where you go out yourself.

出かける.meaningMnemonic: To exit the house on an outing: to go out.
出かける.readingMnemonic: It starts with the kun'yomi で, then かける: でかける.

三日.meaningMnemonic: Three plus day: three days, or the third day of the month.
三日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: みっか. Three is read みっ and day is read か.

三つ.meaningMnemonic: Three plus the つ counting ending: three things.
三つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi みっ plus つ: みっつ.

三.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number three.
三.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi さん, the sand from the kanji.

時々.meaningMnemonic: Time, then time again: from time to time, sometimes.
時々.readingMnemonic: It is とき said twice, and the second one softens to どき: ときどき.

一時.meaningMnemonic: One plus hour: one o'clock, or one moment in time.
一時.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: いち plus じ, the jeep from the kanji: いちじ.

時.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means time or a moment.
時.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi とき, not the jeep reading.

行く.meaningMnemonic: Going as a verb: to go.
行く.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus く: いく.

行う.meaningMnemonic: Going about a task: to perform or carry it out.
行う.readingMnemonic: It uses the longer kun'yomi おこな plus う: おこなう.

行き.meaningMnemonic: The going part of a trip: the way there.
行き.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus き: いき.

見る.meaningMnemonic: See as a verb: to see or to watch.
見る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus る: みる.

見せる.meaningMnemonic: To make someone see: to show.
見せる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus せる: みせる.

見つける.meaningMnemonic: To see something you were looking for: to find it.
見つける.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus つける: みつける.

見える.meaningMnemonic: To be seeable: to be visible or in sight.
見える.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus える: みえる.

見つかる.meaningMnemonic: To get seen at last: to be found.
見つかる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus つかる: みつかる. Compare みつける, where you do the finding.

一月.meaningMnemonic: One plus month: a span of one month.
一月.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ひと plus つき: ひとつき.

月.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the Moon, or a month.
月.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi つき, not the get reading.

年月.meaningMnemonic: Years and months together: a long stretch of time.
年月.readingMnemonic: Both kun'yomi: とし plus つき: としつき.

後ろ.meaningMnemonic: Behind as a place: the back or the rear.
後ろ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi うし plus ろ: うしろ.

後.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means after, or what comes behind.
後.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi あと, not the goat reading.

前.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the front, or before.
前.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi まえ, not the zen reading.

生まれる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi う plus まれる: うまれる.

生きる.meaningMnemonic: Life as a verb: to live.
生きる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus きる: いきる.

生じる.meaningMnemonic: To bring something to life: to produce or cause it.
生じる.readingMnemonic: It uses the on'yomi しょう plus じる: しょうじる.

生.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means life or living.
生.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi せい, the say from the kanji.

一生.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi, squeezed: いち plus しょう becomes いっしょう.

生まれ.meaningMnemonic: Your birth, or the place you were born.
生まれ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi う plus まれ: うまれ, like 生まれる without the る.

人生.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: じん plus せい, the gin and the say: じんせい.

五つ.meaningMnemonic: Five plus the つ counting ending: five things.
五つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi いつ plus つ: いつつ.

五.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number five.
五.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ご, the goat from the kanji.

五日.meaningMnemonic: Five plus day: five days, or the fifth day of the month.
五日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: いつか. Five is read いつ and day is read か.

時間.meaningMnemonic: The interval of time: time, an hour, a period.
時間.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: じ plus かん, the jeep and the can: じかん.

間.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the space between things.
間.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi あいだ, not the can reading.

人間.meaningMnemonic: The one between people: a human being.
人間.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: にん plus けん, and けん softens to げん: にんげん.

年間.meaningMnemonic: The span of a year: during a year.
年間.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ねん plus かん, the nun and the can: ねんかん.

上げる.meaningMnemonic: To move something above: to raise it.
上げる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あ plus げる: あげる.

上.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means above or on top.
上.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi うえ, not the joker reading.

上る.meaningMnemonic: To go above: to rise or go up.
上る.readingMnemonic: Here it uses the kun'yomi あ plus がる, so あがる, like あげる but going up by itself.

東.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひがし, not the toe reading.

四日.meaningMnemonic: Four plus day: four days, or the fourth day of the month.
四日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: よっか. Four is read よっ and day is read か.

四つ.meaningMnemonic: Four plus the つ counting ending: four things.
四つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi よっ plus つ: よっつ.

四.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number four.
四.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi し, the sheep from the kanji. People also say よん.

今日.meaningMnemonic: Now plus day: this day, today.
今日.readingMnemonic: A special reading: きょう. Learn it as one word; the formal こんにち uses both on'yomi, as in こんにちは.

今年.readingMnemonic: An irregular reading: ことし. It uses neither こん nor ねん, so learn it as a whole word.

今.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means now, the present moment.
今.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi いま, not the cone reading.

今月.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: こん, the cone from now, plus げつ, the get from month: こんげつ.

今にも.meaningMnemonic: Now with にも on the end: at any moment, right on the verge of happening.
今にも.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi いま plus にも: いまにも.

今後.meaningMnemonic: Now plus after (the kanji for behind): everything after now, from now on.
今後.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: こん, the cone, plus ご, the goat from behind: こんご.

今に.meaningMnemonic: Now with に added: before long, any time now.
今に.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi いま plus に: いまに.

お金.meaningMnemonic: Gold with the polite お in front: money.
お金.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi かね after the polite お: おかね.

金.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji can mean money, or metal in general.
金.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi かね, not the king reading.

九.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number nine.
九.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi きゅう, the cue from the kanji. You will also hear く.

九日.meaningMnemonic: Nine plus day: nine days, or the ninth day of the month.
九日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: ここのか. Nine is read ここの and day is read か.

九つ.meaningMnemonic: Nine plus the つ counting ending: nine things.
九つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ここの plus つ: ここのつ.

入れる.meaningMnemonic: To make something enter: to put it in, or to let someone in.
入れる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus れる: いれる.

入る.meaningMnemonic: Enter as a verb: to go in or come in.
入る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi はい plus る: はいる. Compare いれる, where you put something else in.

大学.meaningMnemonic: Large plus study: the large place of study, a university.
大学.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: だい, the dye, plus がく, the gawk: だいがく.

学生.meaningMnemonic: Study plus life: someone whose life is study, a student.
学生.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: がく, the gawk, plus せい, the say from life: がくせい.

入学.meaningMnemonic: Enter plus study: entering a school, admission.
入学.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: にゅう, the newt, plus がく, the gawk: にゅうがく.

大学生.meaningMnemonic: University plus life: a university student.
大学生.readingMnemonic: All three on'yomi: だい plus がく plus せい: だいがくせい.

中学.meaningMnemonic: Middle (the kanji for in) plus study: the middle stage of school, junior high school.
中学.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ちゅう, the chew, plus がく, the gawk: ちゅうがく.

学ぶ.meaningMnemonic: Study as a verb: to learn.
学ぶ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi まな plus ぶ: まなぶ.

学.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means learning or scholarship.
学.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi がく, the gawk from the kanji.

高い.meaningMnemonic: Tall plus the い ending: the adjective tall or high. A high price is expensive, so it means that too.
高い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi たか plus い: たかい.

円い.meaningMnemonic: Circle plus the い ending: the adjective round.
円い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi まる plus い: まるい.

円.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a circle, and also the yen, the money of Japan.
円.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi えん, the end from the kanji.

子.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a child or a kid.
子.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi こ, not the sheep reading.

外国.meaningMnemonic: Outside plus country: a country outside your own, a foreign country.
外国.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: がい, the guy, plus こく, the cook: がいこく.

外国人.meaningMnemonic: Foreign country plus person: a person from a foreign country, a foreigner.
外国人.readingMnemonic: All three on'yomi: がい plus こく plus じん, the gin from person: がいこくじん.

外.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the outside, out in the open air.
外.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi そと, not the guy reading.

外出.meaningMnemonic: Outside plus exit: you exit to the outside, so it means going out.
外出.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: がい, the guy, plus しゅつ, the shoots from exit: がいしゅつ.

外す.meaningMnemonic: To put something outside its place: to remove it, take it off, or undo it.
外す.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi はず plus す: はずす.

八つ.meaningMnemonic: Eight plus the つ counting ending: eight things.
八つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi やっ plus つ: やっつ. The shorter やつ also appears.

八日.meaningMnemonic: Eight plus day: eight days, or the eighth day of the month.
八日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: ようか. Eight is read よう and day is read か.

八.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number eight.
八.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi はち, the hatchet from the kanji.

六つ.meaningMnemonic: Six plus the つ counting ending: six things.
六つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi むっ plus つ: むっつ.

六日.meaningMnemonic: Six plus day: six days, or the sixth day of the month.
六日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: むいか. Six is read むい and day is read か.

六.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number six.
六.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ろく, the rock from the kanji.

下.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means below, the space down under something.
下.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi した, not the car reading.

下りる.meaningMnemonic: Below as a verb: to go down, or to come down from somewhere high.
下りる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi お plus りる: おりる.

下げる.meaningMnemonic: To make something go below: to lower it, or to let it hang down.
下げる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi さ plus げる: さげる.

下る.meaningMnemonic: Below as a verb: to come down, to go down, to fall.
下る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi さ plus がる: さがる. It is usually spelled 下がる, while 下る on its own is often read くだる.

下り.meaningMnemonic: Going below: the way down, such as a downhill slope or a train heading out to the end of its line.
下り.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi くだ plus り: くだり.

下す.meaningMnemonic: To bring something below: to take it down, or to lower it.
下す.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi お plus ろす: おろす. It is usually spelled 下ろす, while 下す on its own is often read くだす.

下さる.meaningMnemonic: Something handed down to you from above: someone kindly gives it to you.
下さる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi くだ plus さる: くださる. It is the polite verb behind ください.

来年.meaningMnemonic: Come plus year: the year that is coming, next year.
来年.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: らい, the rye, plus ねん, the nun from year: らいねん.

さ来年.meaningMnemonic: さ in front of next year pushes it one further: the year after next.
さ来年.readingMnemonic: It is さ plus らいねん: さらいねん.

来月.meaningMnemonic: Come plus month: the month that is coming, next month.
来月.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: らい, the rye, plus げつ, the get from month: らいげつ.

来る.meaningMnemonic: Come as a verb: to come, or to arrive.
来る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi く plus る: くる.

さ来月.meaningMnemonic: さ in front of next month pushes it one further: the month after next.
さ来月.readingMnemonic: It is さ plus らいげつ: さらいげつ.

出来るだけ.meaningMnemonic: Exit plus come makes できる, to be able to. Add だけ and it means as much as you can.
出来るだけ.readingMnemonic: Exit is read で and come is read き: できる, then だけ: できるだけ.

来.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means next or coming, as in next year or next spring.
来.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi らい, the rye from the kanji.

気.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means spirit, mind, or the feeling in your heart.
気.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi き, the key from the kanji.

大気.meaningMnemonic: Large plus spirit (air): the great body of air around the earth, the atmosphere.
大気.readingMnemonic: Large uses its other on'yomi たい, plus き, the key: たいき.

気に入る.meaningMnemonic: Something enters your spirit and suits it well: you like it.
気に入る.readingMnemonic: Spirit is read き, then に, then enter is the kun'yomi い plus る: きにいる.

人気.meaningMnemonic: Person plus spirit: the warm feeling people have for something, popularity.
人気.readingMnemonic: Person uses its second on'yomi にん, plus き, the key: にんき.

小さい.meaningMnemonic: Little plus さい: the adjective small or little.
小さい.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ちい plus さい: ちいさい.

小さな.meaningMnemonic: Like 小さい, but it sits right before a noun: a small something.
小さな.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ちい plus さな: ちいさな.

小.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji marks something small, such as a small size or a short month.
小.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi しょう, the show from the kanji.

七日.meaningMnemonic: Seven plus day: seven days, or the seventh day of the month.
七日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: なのか. Seven is read なの and day is read か.

七.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number seven.
七.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi しち, the sheet from the kanji. You will hear なな just as often.

七つ.meaningMnemonic: Seven plus the つ counting ending: seven things.
七つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なな plus つ: ななつ.

山.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a mountain or a hill.
山.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi やま, not the sand reading.

話す.meaningMnemonic: Tale as a verb: to talk, or to speak.
話す.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi はな plus す: はなす.

話.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a talk, a chat, or a story someone tells.
話.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi はなし, not the waffle reading.

女の子.meaningMnemonic: Woman plus の plus child: a female child, a girl.
女の子.readingMnemonic: Both kun'yomi: おんな, then の, then こ: おんなのこ.

女.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a woman.
女.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi おんな, not the jog reading.

女子.meaningMnemonic: Woman plus child: a girl, or women as a group, as on a girls' team.
女子.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: じょ, the jog, plus し, the sheep from child: じょし.

北.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the north.
北.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi きた, not the hockey reading.

午後.meaningMnemonic: Noon plus behind: the part of the day behind noon, the afternoon.
午後.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ご, the goat from noon, plus ご, the goat from behind: ごご.

午前.meaningMnemonic: Noon plus in front: the part of the day in front of noon, the morning.
午前.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ご, the goat, plus ぜん, the zen from in front: ごぜん.

百.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number one hundred.
百.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ひゃく, the yak from the kanji.

書く.meaningMnemonic: Write as a verb: to write something down.
書く.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi か plus く: かく.

先.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the point or tip, the part that goes before the rest.
先.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi さき, not the cent reading.

先生.meaningMnemonic: Before plus life: someone whose life started before yours and who now guides you, a teacher.
先生.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: せん, the cent, plus せい, the say from life: せんせい.

先月.meaningMnemonic: Before plus month: the month before this one, last month.
先月.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: せん, the cent, plus げつ, the get from month: せんげつ.

先ず.meaningMnemonic: Before everything else: first of all, to begin with.
先ず.readingMnemonic: It uses the rare kun'yomi ま plus ず: まず. You will often see it written in kana.

先日.meaningMnemonic: Before plus day: a day before today, the other day.
先日.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: せん, the cent, plus じつ, the second on'yomi of day: せんじつ.

名前.meaningMnemonic: Name plus in front: the name you put in front of yourself, your name.
名前.readingMnemonic: Both kun'yomi: な plus まえ: なまえ.

名.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a name or a title.
名.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi な, not the mane reading.

名人.meaningMnemonic: Name plus person: a person who has made a name for themselves, a master or expert.
名人.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: めい, the mane, plus じん, the gin from person: めいじん.

千.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number one thousand.
千.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi せん, the cent from the kanji.

半.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means half, or partly.
半.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi はん, the hand from the kanji.

半ば.meaningMnemonic: Half plus ば: the halfway point, the middle of something.
半ば.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なか plus ば: なかば.

大半.meaningMnemonic: Large plus half: the larger half, more than half, the majority.
大半.readingMnemonic: Large uses its other on'yomi たい, plus はん, the hand: たいはん.

語学.meaningMnemonic: Word plus study: the study of words and languages.
語学.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ご, the goat, plus がく, the gawk: ごがく.

語.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a word or a language.
語.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ご, the goat from the kanji.

語る.meaningMnemonic: Word as a verb: to tell, or to talk about something at length.
語る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi かた plus る: かたる.

国語.meaningMnemonic: Country plus language: a country's own language, such as the Japanese class at school.
国語.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: こく, the cook, plus ご, the goat: こくご.

土.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means earth, soil, or dirt.
土.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi つち, not the dough reading.

木.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a tree or a bush.
木.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi き, not the bouquet reading.

南.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the south.
南.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi みなみ, not the naan reading.

万.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number ten thousand, or a huge number of things.
万.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi まん, the man from the kanji.

万一.meaningMnemonic: Ten thousand plus one: a one in ten thousand chance, the unlikely worst case.
万一.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: まん, the man, plus いち, the itch from one: まんいち.

白.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the color white, and from that, innocence.
白.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi しろ, not the hawk reading.

白い.meaningMnemonic: White plus the い ending: the adjective white, or blank like an empty page.
白い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi しろ plus い: しろい.

天気.meaningMnemonic: Heavens plus spirit: the mood of the sky, the weather.
天気.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: てん, the tent, plus き, the key: てんき.

右.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the right side, or your right hand.
右.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi みぎ, not the ooze reading.

川.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a river or a stream.
川.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi かわ, not the cent reading. After a place name it often softens to がわ.

水.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means water, especially cool water.
水.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi みず, not the sweet reading.

男の子.meaningMnemonic: Male plus の plus child: a male child, a boy.
男の子.readingMnemonic: Both kun'yomi: おとこ, then の, then こ: おとこのこ.

男.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a man.
男.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi おとこ, not the dance reading.

男の人.meaningMnemonic: Male plus の plus person: a male person, a man.
男の人.readingMnemonic: Both kun'yomi: おとこ, then の, then ひと: おとこのひと.

男子.meaningMnemonic: Male plus child: a boy, or men as a group, as on a boys' team.
男子.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: だん, the dance, plus し, the sheep from child: だんし.

西.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the west.
西.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi にし, not the say reading.

電気.meaningMnemonic: Electricity plus spirit: the power in the wires, and the electric light it gives.
電気.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: でん, the den, plus き, the key: でんき.

電話.meaningMnemonic: Electricity plus talk: talk carried by electricity, a telephone call.
電話.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: でん, the den, plus わ, the waffle from tale: でんわ.

電子.meaningMnemonic: Electricity plus child: the tiny child of electricity, an electron, and so electronic.
電子.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: でん, the den, plus し, the sheep from child: でんし.

学校.meaningMnemonic: Study plus school: a place for study, a school.
学校.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi, squeezed together: がく becomes がっ before こう, the coat: がっこう.

中学校.meaningMnemonic: Middle plus school: the middle school, junior high school.
中学校.readingMnemonic: ちゅう, the chew, plus がっこう, the school word you already know: ちゅうがっこう.

校長.meaningMnemonic: School plus chief (the kanji for long also means leader): the head of a school, the principal.
校長.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: こう, the coat, plus ちょう, the chow from long: こうちょう.

小学校.meaningMnemonic: Little plus school: the school for little ones, elementary school.
小学校.readingMnemonic: しょう, the show, plus がっこう: しょうがっこう.

高校生.meaningMnemonic: High school plus life: someone living the high school life, a high school student.
高校生.readingMnemonic: こうこう, the word for high school, plus せい, the say from life: こうこうせい.

高校.meaningMnemonic: Tall plus school: the high school, senior high school.
高校.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi, and both are こう, two coats in a row: こうこう.

聞く.meaningMnemonic: Hear as a verb: to hear, to listen, or to ask.
聞く.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi き plus く: きく.

聞こえる.meaningMnemonic: Hear with こえる on the end: a sound reaches your ears, so it can be heard.
聞こえる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi き plus こえる: きこえる.

食べる.meaningMnemonic: Eat as a verb: to eat.
食べる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi た plus べる: たべる.

食う.meaningMnemonic: A rougher way to say eat: to eat, or to make a living.
食う.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi く plus う: くう.

電車.meaningMnemonic: Electricity plus car: a car that runs on electricity, an electric train.
電車.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: でん, the den, plus しゃ, the shark: でんしゃ.

車.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a car, or any vehicle.
車.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi くるま, not the shark reading.

何.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means what, or how many.
何.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi なん here, and なに in other places, not the car reading.

何か.meaningMnemonic: What plus か: some what, so something or anything.
何か.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なに plus か: なにか. In casual speech it shrinks to なんか.

何で.meaningMnemonic: What plus で: by what, so why or how.
何で.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なん plus で: なんで.

何でも.meaningMnemonic: What plus でも: whatever it is, so anything at all.
何でも.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なん plus でも: なんでも.

何とか.meaningMnemonic: What plus とか: something or other, or getting by somehow.
何とか.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なん plus とか: なんとか.

毎日.meaningMnemonic: Every plus day: every day, daily.
毎日.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: まい, the mice, plus にち, the niche from day: まいにち.

毎年.meaningMnemonic: Every plus year: every year, yearly.
毎年.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: まい, the mice, plus ねん, the nun: まいねん. People also say まいとし, with the kun'yomi of year.

毎月.meaningMnemonic: Every plus month: every month, monthly.
毎月.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: まい, the mice, plus げつ, the get: まいげつ. You will also hear まいつき.

お母さん.meaningMnemonic: Mother with the polite お in front and さん after it: mom.
お母さん.readingMnemonic: An irregular reading: mother is read かあ here, so おかあさん. Learn it as a whole word.

火.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means fire or a flame.
火.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひ, not the car reading.

読む.meaningMnemonic: Read as a verb: to read, or to recite aloud.
読む.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi よ plus む: よむ.

読書.meaningMnemonic: Read plus write: reading what others have written, the reading of books.
読書.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: どく, the dock, plus しょ, the shore from write: どくしょ.

読み.meaningMnemonic: Read as a noun: a reading, such as the reading of a kanji.
読み.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi よ plus み: よみ.

友.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a friend or a companion.
友.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi とも, not the unicorn reading.

友人.meaningMnemonic: Friend plus person: a person who is your friend.
友人.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ゆう, the unicorn, plus じん, the gin from person: ゆうじん.

休み.meaningMnemonic: Rest plus the み ending makes a noun: a rest or a break.
休み.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi やす plus み. A rest from work is a day you take to yourself.

休む.meaningMnemonic: The verb form of rest: to rest or take a day off.
休む.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi やす plus む. You rest your body by not going to work.

お父さん.meaningMnemonic: Father with polite words on both sides: dad.
お父さん.readingMnemonic: 父 is read とう here, an irregular reading, with the polite お and さん around it.

雨.meaningMnemonic: The rain kanji on its own means rain.
雨.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi あめ. Picture rain falling so hard you shout "ah, meh!"

同じ.meaningMnemonic: Same plus the じ ending means same or identical.
同じ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おな plus じ. Two things that look the same are おなじ.

同一.meaningMnemonic: Same and one: one and the same, identical.
同一.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: どう from same and いつ from one. It is one and the same thing.

同時.meaningMnemonic: Same plus time means the same time.
同時.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: どう from same and じ from time.

力.meaningMnemonic: The power kanji on its own means strength or force.
力.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ちから. Picture a strong person shouting "cheek, a-rah!" while lifting.

問い.meaningMnemonic: Question plus い: a question or query.
問い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi と plus い. A question you ask is a とい.

学問.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: がく from study and もん from question.

明い.meaningMnemonic: Bright as an adjective: light or well lit.
明い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あか plus るい, written あかるい. A bright room is あかるい.

明日.meaningMnemonic: Bright day: the next day, tomorrow.
明日.readingMnemonic: This is a special reading, あした, for the whole word. The bright day that comes next is tomorrow.

明かり.meaningMnemonic: Bright as a noun: a light or glow.
明かり.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あか plus り. A glow in the dark is an あかり.

明ける.meaningMnemonic: Brightening up, so the space is cleared or emptied.
明ける.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あ plus ける. When night brightens, it opens up and clears.

明らか.meaningMnemonic: Bright and plain: clear or obvious.
明らか.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あき plus らか. Something bright and plain to see is clear.

明後日.meaningMnemonic: Bright, after, day: the day after tomorrow.
明後日.readingMnemonic: It has a special reading, あさって, for the whole word, and the on'yomi みょうごにち in formal use.

上京.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: じょう from above and きょう from capital.

目.meaningMnemonic: The eye kanji on its own means eye.
目.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi め. Picture blinking your eye and saying "meh."

言う.meaningMnemonic: Say as a verb: to say.
言う.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus う, said いう and often heard as ゆう.

一言.meaningMnemonic: One word: a single word or brief comment.
一言.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ひと from one and こと from say.

言語.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: げん from say and ご from word.

言わば.meaningMnemonic: Say plus わば: so to speak.
言わば.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus わば. It is a phrase you say to soften a comparison.

体.meaningMnemonic: The body kanji on its own means body.
体.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi からだ. Picture a body so tired you say "car, rah, dah."

大体.meaningMnemonic: The large body of something: generally, on the whole.
大体.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: だい from large and たい from body.

一体.meaningMnemonic: One body: what on earth, used to stress a question.
一体.readingMnemonic: It uses いっ from one, with a small っ, and たい from body.

田.meaningMnemonic: The rice field kanji on its own.
田.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi た. Picture a farmer saying "ta!" to the rice field.

主に.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おも plus に. The main reason is the おも reason.

不.meaningMnemonic: Negative on its own: un or non.
不.readingMnemonic: It uses the on'yomi ふ, the food hook, as a prefix meaning not.

作る.meaningMnemonic: Make as a verb: to make.
作る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi つく plus る. You make things with your hands.

以外.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: い from by means of and がい from outside.

以上.meaningMnemonic: By above: this much and more.
以上.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: い from by means of and じょう from above.

以下.meaningMnemonic: By below: this much and less.
以下.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: い from by means of and か from below.

以来.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: い from by means of and らい from come.

以前.meaningMnemonic: By in front of now: before.
以前.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: い from by means of and ぜん from in front.

多い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おお plus い. Many things make you say "oh, oh!"

売る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi う plus る. You sell things at the market.

売れる.meaningMnemonic: Sell plus れる: to sell well.
売れる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi う plus れる. Goods that sell well are popular.

使う.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi つか plus う. You use a tool.

大使.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: たい from large and し from use.

時計.meaningMnemonic: A thing that measures time: a clock.
時計.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: と, a shortened reading of 時, and けい from measure.

計画.meaningMnemonic: Planning a picture of the future: a plan.
計画.readingMnemonic: Both use on'yomi: けい from plan and かく from picture.

計.meaningMnemonic: A plan or a measuring device.
計.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the on'yomi けい, the cake hook.

計る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi はか plus る. You measure something.

毎朝.readingMnemonic: It uses まい from every and the kun'yomi あさ for morning.

今朝.readingMnemonic: It has a special reading, けさ, for the whole word.

朝.meaningMnemonic: The morning kanji on its own: morning.
朝.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi あさ.

左.meaningMnemonic: The left kanji on its own: the left side.
左.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひだり.

左右.meaningMnemonic: Left and right, side to side.
左右.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: さ from left and ゆう from right.

会う.meaningMnemonic: Meeting as a verb: to meet someone.
会う.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あ plus う.

会話.meaningMnemonic: A meeting of tales: a conversation.
会話.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: かい from meeting and わ from tale.

出会い.meaningMnemonic: Coming out and meeting: an encounter.
出会い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi で from exit and あ from meeting, plus い.

国会.meaningMnemonic: The country's meeting: the National Diet.
国会.readingMnemonic: It uses こっ, a shortened こく from country, and かい from meeting.

大会.meaningMnemonic: A large meeting: a convention or tournament.
大会.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: たい from large and かい from meeting.

会.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the on'yomi かい, the kite hook.

出会う.meaningMnemonic: Come out and meet: to run into someone.
出会う.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi で from exit and あ from meeting, plus う.

大事.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: だい from large and じ from matter.

食事.meaningMnemonic: The matter of eating: a meal.
食事.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: しょく from eat and じ from matter.

火事.meaningMnemonic: A fire matter: a fire that burns a building.
火事.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: か from fire and じ from matter.

事.meaningMnemonic: The matter kanji on its own: a thing or matter.
事.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi こと.

出来事.meaningMnemonic: Something that came out: an event.
出来事.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi で and き, then ごと, a voiced こと (rendaku).

見事.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み from see and ごと, a voiced こと (rendaku).

会社.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: かい from meeting and しゃ from company.

社会.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: しゃ from company and かい from meeting.

社長.meaningMnemonic: The long, senior person of a company: the president.
社長.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: しゃ from company and ちょう from long.

出発.readingMnemonic: It uses しゅっ from exit and ぱつ, はつ with a p sound after the small っ.

発見.meaningMnemonic: Setting out and seeing: a discovery.
発見.readingMnemonic: It uses はっ from departure and けん from see.

発行.readingMnemonic: It uses はっ from departure and こう from going.

発車.meaningMnemonic: The car departs: a train or bus leaving.
発車.readingMnemonic: It uses はっ from departure and しゃ from car.

前者.meaningMnemonic: The one in front: the former.
前者.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: ぜん from in front and しゃ from someone.

学者.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: がく from study and しゃ from someone.

者.meaningMnemonic: Someone on their own: a person.
者.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi もの, sometimes said もん.

後者.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: こう from behind and しゃ from someone.

地.meaningMnemonic: The ground kanji on its own: earth or ground.
地.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the on'yomi ち, the cheetah hook.

地下.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: ち from ground and か from below.

生地.meaningMnemonic: The raw ground of clothing: fabric.
生地.readingMnemonic: It uses the irregular き from life and じ from ground.

土地.meaningMnemonic: Soil and ground: a plot of land.
土地.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: と from soil and ち from ground.

方.meaningMnemonic: A direction, or a polite word for a person.
方.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi かた.

一方.meaningMnemonic: One direction: one side, or on the other hand.
一方.readingMnemonic: It uses いっ from one and ぽう, ほう with a p sound after the small っ.

方々.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi かた, then がた, voiced (rendaku). The 々 repeats the kanji.

地方.meaningMnemonic: A direction of the land: a region.
地方.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: ち from ground and ほう from direction.

新聞.meaningMnemonic: New things you hear: a newspaper.
新聞.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: しん from new and ぶん from hear.

新しい.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あたら plus しい.

新聞社.readingMnemonic: It uses しん, ぶん, and しゃ, all on'yomi.

新た.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あら plus た.

会場.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: かい from meeting and じょう from location.

入場.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: にゅう from enter and じょう from location.

場.meaningMnemonic: The location kanji on its own: a place.
場.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ば.

会員.meaningMnemonic: A member of the meeting: a member.
会員.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use on'yomi: かい from meeting and いん from employee.

立つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi た plus つ.

立てる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi た plus てる.

立ち上がる.meaningMnemonic: Stand and go up: to get up.
立ち上がる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi た from stand and あ from above, then がる.

立場.meaningMnemonic: The place where you stand: your position.
立場.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi たち from stand and ば from location.

開ける.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あ plus ける.

開く.meaningMnemonic: To open, or to come open.
開く.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あ plus く.

上手.meaningMnemonic: A hand above the rest: skillful.
上手.readingMnemonic: It has an irregular reading: じょう from above and ず from hand.

手.meaningMnemonic: The hand kanji on its own: a hand.
